name: Chain Breaker
passiveDesc: For every party member from Natlan or who has a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the equipping character gains 4.8%/6%/7.2%/8.4%/9.6% increased ATK. When there are no less than 3 of the aforementioned characters, the equipping character gains 24/30/36/42/48 Elemental Mastery.
description: A jade-adorned longbow. The gentle winds always seem to swirl gently about its string. Legends claim that this weapon was made in a far more ancient era by a dragon artisan.
